quotes: He who knows he has enough is rich.||Lao Tzu
Progress you can't see is still progress. Keep showing up.
Rest is part of the work, not a break from it.
Compare today's you with yesterday's you. Nobody else.
posts.caption:
Enough is a quiet kind of wealth. 🌱

Lao Tzu, Tao Te Ching, chapter 33 (translations vary). General psychology ideas, not medical advice.

quotes: The soul becomes dyed with the color of its thoughts.||Marcus Aurelius
posts.caption:
Choose your thoughts with care. 🧘

Marcus Aurelius, Meditations 5.16 (Hays-style translation; wording varies).

quotes: Wish for things to happen as they do, and you will be happy.||Epictetus
Motivation follows action more often than it leads it.
Make the good habit easy and the bad habit slightly harder.
Be kind to yourself on the days you miss. Then begin again.
posts.caption:
Peace is acceptance, practiced daily. 🔑

Epictetus, Enchiridion 8 (paraphrased; translations vary). General psychology ideas, not medical advice.

quotes: It is not death that a man should fear, but he should fear never beginning to live.||Marcus Aurelius
posts.caption:
Begin to live today. 🌅

Marcus Aurelius, Meditations 12.1 (commonly cited translation).
